messages:
liz_p: Heads-up — ACME pilot wants to top up their private marketplace commit mid-contract. Need routing + joint announce plan with HW partner and SI. Who owns the end-to-end?
sam_sales: Quick Q: can we top up under existing PO or do we need an amendment/new private offer? Customer wants +30% commit.
pranav_si: SI note: their SOW ties to current commit end date. If we increase capacity we need an SOW amendment and we'll ask for co-marketing. They also requested a 2-week joint announce window (embargo).
alex_field: Proposed flow: 1) confirm Dedicated capacity availability 2) draft private-offer amendment (delta commit + billing SKU map) 3) route to HW partner for kicker/rebate alignment 4) submit to Partner Portal 5) schedule announce cadence (2wk embargo) 6) sync renewal cliff with SI SOW.
liz_p: Who owns Marketplace listing change / SKU remap?
marketplace-bot: Reminder: private-offer amendments must go through Partner Portal. Example API snippet: ```PATCH /partner/offers/{offer_id} { "commit_delta": 0.30, "effective_date": "2024-11-18" }```
kate_pm: Legal needs to review any pricing/term change (target 3 business days). Partner Ops needs 48 hours to reconcile SKUs.
sam_sales: Pricing guardrail: avoid creating a deeper discount band midterm. Suggest we treat top-up as additive (same effective unit price) rather than a new tier.
pranav_si: SI requests a hardware kicker: 10% rebate if they hit a 3-quarter consumption milestone. That requires HW partner sign-off and ops mapping.
alex_field: I'll draft the amendment template with: commit delta, billing SKU map, renewal alignment, and a short Partner Portal checklist. ETA EOD.
liz_p: I'll loop in Legal + Partner Ops when Alex posts the draft. @pranav_si can you confirm SI co-marketing assets readiness for the 2-week announce window?
pranav_si: We can deliver co-marketing assets in ~10 business days pending HW partner logo approval.
kate_pm: Ops note: bundling with HW SKUs (appliance/offline) converts this into a new private offer in the marketplace and adds ~5 business days. Flagging for timeline.
sam_sales: Renewal ops: set automatic renewal trigger synced to SI SOW end date so Sales gets an alert 30 days before the cliff.
liz_p: Owners: liz_p to coordinate Legal + Partner Ops, alex_field to draft amendment, pranav_si to confirm SI assets & HW kicker feasibility, sam_sales to confirm pricing floor and PO structure. I'll post a checklist once draft lands.
liz_p: Draft checklist posted: ```- Confirm Dedicated capacity (infra)
- Amendment draft (alex_field)
- Legal review (kate_pm)
- Partner Ops SKU reconcile
- HW partner signoff on kicker
- Submit Partner Portal amendment
- Schedule joint announce (2wk embargo)
- Configure renewal trigger sync to SI SOW (sales alerts)```
kate_pm: If Legal requests contract redlines, add +2 business days. Keep that contingency in the timeline.
liz_p: Thanks — next sync at standup tomorrow 10am to close blockers. If anything urgent, ping me or escalate to partner execs. :thumbsup:
